admission.authority: direct user continuation of the main-backed BRC multiplier program through Round 7
admission.reason: Compose exact retained BRC multiplier states with a second vertical Fermat coordinate and safe periodic residue-wheel observers, materializing large exact gaps only on surviving fibers.

methods.name: BRC multiplier x vertical residue-wheel / lazy exact gap calculus
capabilities: exact vertical gap formula D_t=D_0+t(2x_0+t) from retained horizontal BRC state
exact period-M necessary squarehood wheel in the t coordinate
zero-false-negative first-stage wheel plus second residue filter
lazy exact materialization of D_t only after both residue observers pass
methods.core_law: For fixed m,N and x_0=ceil(sqrt(mN)), D_t=(x_0+t)^2-mN is periodic modulo M as a function of t mod M. Therefore every exact square hit lies in W_M={r:(x_0+r)^2-mN is a quadratic residue mod M}. Enumerating only translated copies of W_M is observer-safe for squarehood rejection; exact D_t can be reconstructed as D_0+t(2x_0+t) only after surviving all declared modular observers.
methods.hard_boundary: Vertical Fermat search, additive gap recurrence, congruence stepping, quadratic-residue sieving, and Lehman/Hart factoring are classical prior art. The adaptive 1008/20160 wheel threshold is a finite Python benchmark policy, not a theorem. Timing gains inside a fixed search rectangle do not reduce the classical rectangle size or imply an asymptotic factoring improvement. No Foundation promotion is made.
